name: camayoc_ex_who_said_this
description: Provenance for a subject: every claim aegis:about it, with its sourceKind (the reader's trust signal), who decided it when that is recorded, and when it was observed when it was an observation.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?claim ?label ?sourceKind ?decidedBy ?observedAt WHERE { ?claim aegis:about <{subject}> ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:sourceKind ?sourceKind . OPTIONAL { ?claim aegis:decidedBy ?decidedBy } OPTIONAL { ?claim aegis:observedAt ?observedAt } } ORDER BY ?label
